dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, which job is more stressful, a doctor or a teacher?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwɪtʃ ˈdʒɑːb ɪz ˈmɔːr ˈstrɛsfəl, ə ˈdɑːktər ɔːr ə ˈtiːtʃər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think a doctor's job is more stressful. Doctors work long hours.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ə ˈdɑːktərz ˈdʒɑːb ɪz ˈmɔːr ˈstrɛsfəl. ˈdɑːktərz ˈwɜːrk ˌlɔːŋ ˈaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. But doctors are well-paid.
dialogue.reading: ˈðæts ˈraɪt. bʌt ˈdɑːktərz ər ˌwɛlˈpeɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. They earn more than teachers.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðeɪ ˈɜːrn ˈmɔːr ðən ˈtiːtʃərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, what's the best job in the world?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈwʌts ðə ˈbɛst ˈdʒɑːb ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: For me, teaching! It's my dream job.
dialogue.reading: fər miː, ˈtiːtʃɪŋ! ɪts maɪ ˌdriːm ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: But it isn't the best-paid job.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ɪt ˈɪzənt ðə ˌbɛst ˈpeɪd ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. But it's the most interesting job, and I love it!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. bʌt ɪts ðə ˈmoʊst ˈɪntrəstɪŋ ˈdʒɑːb, ənd aɪ ˈlʌv ɪt!
